Xi Jinping Visits Washington for Talks with Donald Trump

Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for a state visit with U.S. President Donald Trump. Discussions were scheduled to focus on global issues including trade, artificial intelligence, Iran, and Taiwan. The visit occurred as global markets were rattled by war, with China reportedly possessing new energy leverage.
